result.gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(c."DESCRICAO", 'SEM INFORMACAO') AS metodo_contraceptivo, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN contraceptivos c ON i."CONTRACEP1" = c."CONTRACEPTIVO" WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2 GROUP BY COALESCE(c."DESCRICAO", 'SEM INFORMACAO') ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC;
